items.name: Budget Justification Generator
items.description: Uploads a grant budget form, the project narrative / proposal, and optionally the funding opportunity announcement, and returns a publication-ready RA-friendly Markdown budget-justification narrative document organized in standard R&R Budget / SF-424A category order (A. Senior/Key Personnel through H. Indirect Costs, plus Cost Sharing and Budget Summary). Includes summary tables at fixed positions and a Cross-Validation Notes section marked as RA-only / not-for-submission. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping budget-justification-generator consolidation.md conventions.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200)
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary regulatory KB — 2 CFR 200 Subpart E covers cost principles including allowable / unallowable categories. For CAS-triggering proposals, swap in Cost Accounting Standards (CAS). For agency-specific budget guidance, swap in NSF PAPPG / NIH GPS / DOE / DOD. For effort and salary calculations, pair with Effort Reporting & Compensation.

data.name: extract-personnel-and-fringe
data.prompt:
You are extracting personnel data AND generating professional
justification narrative for Sections A (Senior/Key Personnel),
B (Other Personnel), and C (Fringe Benefits). You receive the
uploaded documents AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Reproduce financial figures verbatim. Tie
each person's effort / salary to roles in the project
narrative.

CRITICAL — monetary structured-data fields are FLAT STRINGS
preserving $X,XXX.XX format. Section narrative fields are
professional third-person prose.

Emit a JSON object with: project_title, pi_name,
sponsoring_agency (all STRING),
senior_key_personnel (JSON ARRAY of {name, title, role,
person_months, salary_basis, requested_salary}),
other_personnel (JSON ARRAY of {category, count,
person_months, rate} or empty),
total_senior_personnel_cost (STRING),
total_other_personnel_cost (STRING or null),
fringe_benefit_rates (JSON ARRAY of {category, rate,
calculation_basis}),
total_fringe_benefits (STRING),
is_salary_cap_applicable (BOOLEAN or null),
salary_cap_amount (STRING or null),
is_multi_year_budget (BOOLEAN or null),
year_over_year_personnel_changes (STRING or null),
section_a_narrative (STRING — professional Section A prose),
section_b_narrative (STRING — professional Section B prose;
use "No other personnel costs are requested for this
project." when other_personnel is empty),
section_c_narrative (STRING — professional Section C prose).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-equipment-and-travel
data.prompt:
You are extracting equipment and travel data AND generating
professional justification narrative for Sections D
(Equipment) and E (Travel: Domestic + Foreign).

Emit a JSON object with: equipment_items (JSON ARRAY of
{name, cost, purpose}), total_equipment_cost (STRING),
equipment_threshold_applied (STRING or null),
domestic_travel (JSON ARRAY of {destination, purpose,
travelers, duration_days, cost_breakdown}),
foreign_travel (JSON ARRAY of same shape),
total_domestic_travel_cost (STRING),
total_foreign_travel_cost (STRING),
is_foreign_travel_restricted (BOOLEAN or null),
travel_cost_basis (STRING — GSA rates, quotes, etc.),
section_d_narrative (STRING — use "No equipment costs are
requested for this project." when empty),
section_e_domestic_narrative (STRING),
section_e_foreign_narrative (STRING — use "No foreign travel
costs are requested for this project." when empty).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-participant-support-and-odc
data.prompt:
You are extracting participant support and Other Direct Costs
data AND generating professional justification narrative for
Sections F (Participant/Trainee Support) and G (Other Direct
Costs subcategories G.1-G.9).

Emit a JSON object with: participant_support_costs (JSON
ARRAY of {category, cost}),
total_participant_support (STRING),
materials_and_supplies (JSON ARRAY of {category, cost}),
publication_costs (STRING or null),
consultant_services (JSON ARRAY of {name_or_tbd, rate, days,
total, scope}),
adp_computing_services (STRING or null),
subaward_details (JSON ARRAY of {institution, pi, scope,
total_cost, under_25k_mtdc, over_25k_mtdc}),
total_subaward_costs (STRING),
equipment_rental (STRING or null),
alterations_renovations (STRING or null),
tuition_remission (STRING or null),
other_direct_costs_other (JSON ARRAY of {category, cost}),
total_other_direct_costs (STRING),
section_f_narrative (STRING — use "No participant/trainee
support costs are requested for this project." when empty),
section_g_narrative (STRING — covers G.1-G.9 in order with
### subsection headers).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-indirect-and-summary
data.prompt:
You are extracting indirect cost, cost share, and budget
summary data AND generating professional justification
narrative for Section H (Indirect Costs), Cost Sharing, and
Budget Summary. Check the NOFO for F&A caps, cost share
requirements, and formatting rules.

Emit a JSON object with: fa_rate_percentage (STRING),
fa_base_type (STRING — MTDC, TDC, Salaries & Wages, etc.),
fa_rate_type (STRING — on-campus, off-campus, federally
negotiated, etc.),
mtdc_base_exclusions (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
is_fa_rate_capped (BOOLEAN or null),
fa_rate_cap_details (STRING or null),
total_direct_costs (STRING),
total_indirect_costs (STRING),
total_project_costs (STRING),
cost_share_required (BOOLEAN or null),
cost_share_amount (STRING or null),
cost_share_type (STRING or null — cash, in-kind, third-party,
waived IDC),
cost_share_sources (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS or empty),
budget_period_summary (JSON ARRAY of {period, direct_costs,
indirect_costs, total} objects for multi-year budgets, or
empty for single-year),
year_over_year_variations (STRING or null),
nofo_budget_rules (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS or empty),
nofo_page_limit_for_justification (STRING or null),
section_h_narrative (STRING — H. Indirect Costs prose, with
MTDC calculation shown),
cost_share_narrative (STRING — use "No cost sharing is
required for this project and none is proposed." when not
required),
budget_summary_narrative (STRING — overview paragraph with
totals and year-over-year explanation).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: budget-justification-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Budget Justification
Generator workflow. You receive FOUR JSON fragments from the
previous step (Personnel & Fringe; Equipment & Travel;
Participant Support & ODC; Indirect Costs & Summary).

Assemble the publication-ready Markdown budget-justification
narrative in standard R&R Budget / SF-424A category order
(A through I + Cost Sharing + Budget Summary), with a
Cross-Validation Notes section at the end marked as RA-only.

CRITICAL — Cross-validation:
1. Personnel & Fringe subtotal:
   total_senior_personnel_cost + total_other_personnel_cost +
   total_fringe_benefits = sum.
2. Non-personnel direct subtotal:
   total_equipment + total_domestic_travel +
   total_foreign_travel + total_participant_support +
   total_other_direct_costs.
3. Total Direct Costs check:
   Personnel + Equipment + Travel + Participant Support +
   ODC = total_direct_costs.
4. Total Project Costs check:
   total_direct_costs + total_indirect_costs =
   total_project_costs.

DO NOT alter any dollar amounts to make math work. Flag
discrepancies in CROSS-VALIDATION NOTES with PASS/FAIL
format.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

```
BUDGET JUSTIFICATION
====================
```

(Use literal `=` underline in the title block — this matches
source consolidation.md template.)

<project_title>
<pi_name>

**[FORMATTING ADVISORY — include this block ONLY when
`nofo_budget_rules` or `nofo_page_limit_for_justification`
is populated. Otherwise OMIT entirely.]**

- Page limit: <nofo_page_limit_for_justification>
- Other formatting requirements: <bullets from nofo_budget_rules>

---

## A. SENIOR/KEY PERSONNEL

<section_a_narrative>

---

## B. OTHER PERSONNEL

<section_b_narrative>

---

## C. FRINGE BENEFITS

<section_c_narrative>

**Personnel Summary Table:**

| Name | Role | Person-Months | Requested Salary | Fringe | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

One row per senior_key_personnel entry + aggregated rows for
other_personnel categories + total row.

---

## D. EQUIPMENT

<section_d_narrative>

---

## E. TRAVEL

### Domestic Travel

<section_e_domestic_narrative>

### Foreign Travel

<section_e_foreign_narrative>

**Travel Summary Table:**

| Destination | Purpose | Travelers | Duration | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|

One row per domestic_travel + foreign_travel entry + total
row.

---

## F. PARTICIPANT/TRAINEE SUPPORT COSTS

<section_f_narrative>

---

## G. OTHER DIRECT COSTS

<section_g_narrative — already contains ### G.1 through
### G.9 subsections>

**Other Direct Costs Summary Table:**

| Subcategory | Amount |
|---|---|

One row per G subcategory (G.1 Materials, G.2 Publications,
G.3 Consultants, G.4 ADP, G.5 Subawards, G.6 Equipment Rental,
G.7 Alterations, G.8 Tuition Remission, G.9 Other) + total
row.

---

## H. INDIRECT COSTS (FACILITIES & ADMINISTRATIVE)

<section_h_narrative>

---

## COST SHARING

<cost_share_narrative>

---

## BUDGET SUMMARY

<budget_summary_narrative>

**Budget Summary Table:**

When budget_period_summary is non-empty (multi-year):

| Period | Direct Costs | Indirect Costs | Total |
|---|---|---|---|

One row per period entry + total row.

When single-year, render a one-row total:

| Year 1 | <total_direct_costs> | <total_indirect_costs> | <total_project_costs> |

---

## CROSS-VALIDATION NOTES

**For the RA's internal review only — NOT for submission to
the sponsor.**

### Arithmetic Checks

- **Personnel & Fringe subtotal:** PASS/FAIL ($X + $Y + $Z = $W)
- **Non-personnel direct subtotal:** PASS/FAIL (sum = $X)
- **Total Direct Costs:** PASS/FAIL ($X expected, $Y stated)
- **Total Project Costs:** PASS/FAIL ($X expected, $Y stated)

### Items Requiring PI Clarification

Bulleted list of any placeholder text ("clarification needed
from PI", "not specified in the provided documents") found in
the narratives. If none, state "No items requiring PI
clarification were identified."

### Missing or Incomplete Sections

Bulleted list of any budget categories with $0 or empty
narrative. If complete, state "All budget categories have
been addressed."

## Rendering rules

- Use `##` for main section headings (A through H, Cost
  Sharing, Budget Summary, Cross-Validation Notes).
- Use `###` for subsections (E. Domestic / Foreign Travel,
  G.1-G.9 subcategories).
- Format dollar amounts as `$X,XXX.XX` consistently.
- Bold all field labels and totals.
- Horizontal rules between major sections.
- Title block uses `=` underline (plain-text style at the
  top — not a Markdown header — matches source convention).
- Cross-Validation Notes section is the LAST section and
  must be clearly marked as RA-only / not-for-submission so
  an RA can delete everything from that heading down and
  have a clean submission-ready document.
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE
  into prose / table.
- Do NOT modify dollar amounts to make math work. Flag.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.check_name: Line item sum equals category total
validation_plan.check_description: Verify sum of line items equals category total for each R&R Budget category.
Verify total_direct_costs + total_indirect_costs equals total_project_costs; flag any discrepancy in CROSS-VALIDATION NOTES without altering values.
Verify personnel cost calculations are consistent with FTE / person-months in the budget.
